title: Mariana drops in
brief: You're Tomás. Your childhood friend Mariana turns up at the café after twenty years. She wants the news: how you are, where Vale is, how Don Hernando is doing. You're thirsty and a little nervous. Find out where Don Hernando lives so you can visit him.

turns.npcEn: Tomás! How's it going? How are you?
turns.intent: Say you're fine, but a bit nervous.
Say no thanks, you're thirsty: a juice, please.
accept: No, gracias. Tengo sed. Un jugo, por favor.
Tengo sed. Un jugo, por favor.
No, tengo sed. ¿Un jugo, por favor?

turns.npc: Listo, un jugo de mora. ¿Y Vale? ¿Está en el café?
turns.npcEn: Sure, a blackberry juice. And Vale? Is she at the café?
turns.intent: Say no, she's at the bank with Mr Ruiz.
accept: No, está en el banco con el señor Ruiz.
No, Vale está en el banco con el señor Ruiz.
No. Está en el banco, con el señor Ruiz.

turns.npc: ¿Con el señor Ruiz? Uf. Y don Hernando está enfermo, ¿sabes? No está bien.
turns.npcEn: With Mr Ruiz? Ugh. And Don Hernando is ill, you know? He's not well.
turns.intent: Ask Mariana where Don Hernando lives.

turns.npc: Vive aquí, en el barrio, en la calle catorce. El número doce.
turns.npcEn: He lives here, in the neighbourhood, on Fourteenth Street. Number twelve.
turns.intent: Thank her, and repeat the address so you remember it.
accept: Gracias, Mariana. Calle catorce, número doce.
Muchas gracias. La calle catorce, el número doce.
Muy amable, Mariana. Calle catorce, número doce.
